title: 0.5.5e Patch Notes
author: Alexander_GGG
excerpt:
Added a new Texture Quality setting for machines with low VRAM.
Fixed a bug where killing some specific bosses would prevent Ritual encounters from starting.
Fixed a bug where the Tomb of the Fallen Knight could not be accessed.
notes: Official Early Access Patch Notes thread, read on 2026-10-06. This is a SUMMARY, not a byte-exact capture: the page was fetched and reduced by a language model, so the excerpt is a reported reading of the first three bullet lines rather than stored source bytes. Enough to name the live patch; never enough to certify compatibility. The forum listing on the same day showed 0.5.5e as the newest thread, above 0.5.5d (2026-09-28), 0.5.5c (2026-09-18), 0.5.5b (2026-09-11) and 0.5.5 (2026-09-03).
